name: Rainoff Camp
source:
First day on the job. Welcome to the camp where it never rains. Here you will spend the rest of the year together with your co-workers. Maybe you get to know them better, become friends with them, have a good time, or they just won't like you.

Let's see what happens first.
translation:
上班第一天。欢迎来到从不下雨的营地。你将在这里与同事一起度过今年剩余的时间。也许你会更好地了解他们，与他们成为朋友，度过一段愉快的时光，或者他们只是不会喜欢你。

我们先看看会发生什么。
